## Goal
Per CP-03: existing-browser (Playwright) tests that the header menu works: visible menu links stay inside 320/360/390/414px viewports, keyboard opening, Escape closing and focus return for the native popover, desktop navigation visible, light and dark. The known tab-out limitation is accepted backlog, not a defect. Reuse the method of tools/site_shots.py without editing it.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests pass offline against the built site (pnpm --dir web build first); ruff clean.
- Any real defect: report it; a strict xfail only on that one case, with reason, and stop for owner disposition.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)

- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Header components, scripts, styles, tools/site_shots.py, existing tests.
